customer_question: We're developing a device using an already-qualified CC2640R2F module. What testing is required for Bluetooth SIG certification of our product?
question_variants: Does our product need RF PHY testing if it uses a pre-qualified Bluetooth module?
Is profile testing required if our device doesn't implement any SIG-defined profiles?
What test exemptions apply when using a module with a built-in (chip) antenna?
actual_issue: The customer is developing a device incorporating a CC2640R2F Bluetooth module (already separately qualified) and requested a quote and test scope determination for their own Bluetooth SIG certification.
plain_english_explanation: Before quoting, the consultant checked the CC2640R2F module's datasheet and confirmed it has an integrated (built-in) antenna. Because the antenna is built into the already-qualified module (not a separate/external antenna design the end product manufacturer controls), RF PHY testing is not required for the end product. Additionally, if the end product does not implement any Bluetooth SIG-established profiles (e.g., A2DP, HID, etc. - only using the core radio/module functionality), then Profile testing is also not required.
consultant_answer: We confirmed via the datasheet that the CC2640R2F module has a built-in antenna, so RF PHY testing is not required. If you are not implementing any SIG-established profiles, Profile testing is also not required. Based on these conditions, our quote is: registration support (Single Design reference) ¥150,000, plus Compliance Folder creation ¥150,000 (in addition, the applicant remits the $11,040 registration fee to SIG directly).
decision_logic: When a product uses a pre-qualified module, check the module's datasheet to confirm whether its antenna is integrated/built-in - if so, RF PHY testing for the end product can be exempted. Separately, check whether the end product implements any SIG-established profiles - if none are implemented, Profile testing is also not required. Combine both exemptions when quoting registration scope (e.g., Single Design reference support plus Compliance Folder creation).
final_recommendation: For products using a pre-qualified module with a confirmed built-in antenna and no implemented SIG profiles, quote registration support without RF PHY or Profile testing - just registration support (appropriate reference type) and Compliance Folder creation, plus the SIG registration fee.
risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrectly assuming RF PHY exemption without verifying the module's antenna is truly built-in (vs. requiring an external antenna design subject to RF testing) could result in an invalid registration. Conversely, requiring unnecessary RF PHY or Profile testing for a device that qualifies for these exemptions would needlessly increase cost and timeline for the customer.
